Title: CyrenaBuilder - Application Builder

Content:
## CyrenaBuilder

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Options`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
The main application builder for Cyréna. Configures DI services, feature options, assemblies, build actions, and run actions.

### Static Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `AppDataDirectory` | `string` | `{LocalApplicationData}/.cyrena` |
| `UserContentDirectory` | `string` | `{AppDataDirectory}/public` |

### Constructor
```csharp
public CyrenaBuilder(IServiceCollection services)
```

### Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `Services` | `IServiceCollection` | The DI service collection |
| `FeatureAssemblies` | `IDictionary<string, IList<Assembly>>` | Assemblies grouped by feature key |
| `FeatureOptions` | `IDictionary<string, object>` | Named feature options |
| `BuildActions` | `IList<Action<CyrenaBuilder>>` | Actions to run during Build() |
| `RunActions` | `IList<Action<IServiceProvider, CancellationToken>>` | Actions to run at startup |

### Methods

#### AddBuildAction(Action<CyrenaBuilder> action)
Adds an action to run during `Build()`.

#### AddRunAction(Action<IServiceProvider, CancellationToken> action)
Adds an action to run at application startup.

#### GetLifetimeCT()
Returns the application lifetime cancellation token.

#### CancelLifetimeCT()
Cancels the application lifetime token.

#### Build()
Executes all build actions and registers `CyrenaOptions` as a singleton.

### Usage
```csharp
var builder = new CyrenaBuilder(services);
builder.AddAssistantMode<DefaultAssistantMode>();
builder.AddAssistantPlugin<DefaultAssistantPlugin>();
builder.AddFeatureOption(new MyFeatureOptions());
builder.Build();
```
